This is a great hotel with excellent value for money. I stayed here for four nights and was totally satisfied. The staff is extremely friendly and helpful. I've had multiple meals from in-room dining and also enjoyed the coffee shop on the ground floor - it was all delicious. It's a very quite neighborhood and not far from the airport at all. Highly recommended.

We had a wonderful time at this hotel. The Staff was very friendly. The room is very comfortable and quiet.
We arrived at 4am and there was someone waiting for us at the reception. It's excellent if you arrive at middle night
